$comment: Frontmatter schema for docs/plan/units/*.md. Flat keys only (see tool/lib/frontmatter.mjs). Validated by tool/check-units.mjs.

id.$comment: U = real unit, E = harness eval unit

tier.$comment: 1 docs/pure code: PR only · 2 service/UI: plan approval + PR · 3 adapters/auth/sources: plan approval + mandatory reviewers + PR + human beta run

allowed_files.$comment: repo-relative paths or globs the unit may touch; anything else is a gate failure

adrs.$comment: ADR ids the reviewer checks against, e.g. ADR-0005

design.$comment: docs/design sections a UI unit implements, e.g. components.md#Table

dod.$comment: machine-checkable Definition of Done items; each must name a command or a test

estimate.$comment: S (≤ 1 session) · M (1 session) · L (split it)
